title: A proper finitely presented scheme descends to one proper Noetherian stage
statement: Let $g:Y\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated (its diagonal is quasi-compact). Let $N=(I,D,\pi)$ be a Noetherian approximation of $S$ [def-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system]. There exist $a\in I$, a scheme $Y_0$, a proper, locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism $p:Y_0\to D_a$, and $h:Y\to Y_0$, such that the commuting square with top $h$, left $g$, right $p$ and bottom $\pi_a:S\to D_a$ is cartesian. This is a single-stage descent assertion, with no construction of models for a general proper $X$.

proof.text: Reindex the given approximation by a nonempty directed partial order using IsFiltered.exists_directed applied to N.I opposite. Its leftOp functor is initial, so whiskering the approximation cone retains S as the limit.

Apply Scheme.exists_isPullback_of_finitePresentation to g over this limit. Obtain p at a stage and its cartesian square H. The source of p is qcqs because p is finitely presented over a Noetherian stage.

Identify the limit pullback projection of p with g via H.isoPullback. Its map to the pullback of the identity of the base is proper: composition with the second projection equals that proper projection, and this second projection is an isomorphism. Apply exists_isProper_baseChange_of_isLimit to p and the identity of the stage to obtain a later stage where p is proper.

At this later stage choose p prime = pullback.snd p t. Composing the map returned by eventual properness with the second projection of the pullback of the identity gives p prime, so it is proper. Its finite-presentation properties are preserved by base change. Form h prime by pullback.lift h (g followed by the new cone leg). The cone equation and H.w give the required equality. IsPullback.of_right cancels the right pullback square to obtain the new square. Return the corresponding object in the original approximation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_proper_noetherian_stage
    {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ S) [IsProper g]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    (N : S.NoetherianApproximation) :
    ∃ (a : N.I) (Y₀ : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y₀ ⟶ N.D.obj a) (h : Y ⟶ Y₀),
      IsProper p ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation p ∧ QuasiCompact p ∧
        QuasiSeparated p ∧ IsPullback h g p (N.π.app a)
